newsitem.title: CHINA: China port sets international container service.
newsitem.headline: China port sets international container service.

text.p: Yingkou port in China's northeastern province of Liaoning has started regular international container service, the China Daily said on Friday.
The service linked Yingkou with ports in South Korea, Japan, and Hong Kong as well as other destinations, the newspaper said.

Container service would be handled by the Yingkou Cosco International Container Harbour Co Ltd, set up by port authorities and the China Ocean Shipping Co, China's big shipping line, the newspaper said.
The China Ocean Shipping group of companies includes Hong Kong listed COSCO Pacific Ltd.
Yingkou can handle a single 15,000-tonne container ship or two 5,000-tonne vessels. The port handles more than 11.5 million tonnes of cargo a year, the newspaper said.
Much of the harbour's cargo included metal ore, aluminium and fertiliser, it said.
